title: Profit-taking after a 13% run: Nifty falls 159 points to 25,228 as Titan and metals slide
short: Profit-taking hits: Nifty down 159 pts at 25,228, Titan −5.3%
dek: The Nifty fell 0.63% and the Sensex lost 500.38 points to 82,031.81 after a rally of about 13% in 12 sessions. Consumer durables and metals fell up to 3%, while SBI and Cipla held up. The rupee edged up 7 paise to 93.44.
card: Nifty −159.45 at 25,227.95, Sensex −500.38 at 82,031.81. Metal −2.46%, Titan −5.3%. Rupee 93.44, Brent near $92.
